IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair in a messy high
bun wears a fitted black mock-neck zip crop top with
long sleeves and thumbholes, a small embroidered
logo, and a silver-buckled black belt over black wide
cargo trousers. Her expression is calm and direct. A
pale studio backdrop with a white car in the
background. Palette of black, ivory, and silver. Sleek
and sporty, in the style of a minimal activewear
campaign.
Sleek, sporty, modern
WORKING NOTES
- The thumbholes and silver buckle are the signature
details.
- Keep the white car for a sleek garage setting.
